HCI Researcher · Kyung Hee University

Yunseo Do.

Exploring how people and intelligent systems interact in the physical world.

I am an undergraduate researcher at the Human & Interactive Technology Lab (ITEM) at Kyung Hee University, advised by Prof. Seungjae Oh. My interests span human–AI interaction, physical AI, and haptic shared control.

Previously, I was a research intern in the Environmental Safety Group at KIST Europe.

Research & projects

Questions, ideas, and things built.

My current interests are human–AI interaction, AI-based interaction, physical AI, and haptic shared control.

01
Research paperKSC 2025

Gaze-Conditioned Grasp Synthesis via 2D Segmentation and 3D Reconstruction

A gaze-conditioned pipeline identifies a fixated object in egocentric images, reconstructs it in 3D, and synthesizes human grasps.

Human–AI interaction
02
Research project2024

T2VSum: Multimodal Video Summarization through Text-Derived Video Features

An exploration of text-derived video features for summarization when some video frames are damaged.

Multimodal AI

Open-source toolGitHub

arXiv Save As Title
